messages:
maya: planning a small v2 roll in eu-west tonight 02:15-02:45 UTC. aim: validate header negotiation and prober behavior.
raj: i can watch the canary. what's the plan and recovery?
maya: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100% over 20m. probe-level pin for failing probes (30m). mobile SDK ok with 1h pin if needed.
ops-jen: runbook updated, release-notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/432
deploy-bot: /schedule rollout v2 --region eu-west --window 2025-04-01T02:15Z/2025-04-01T02:45Z --canary 3% --probe header-sniff
deploy-bot: job 9007 scheduled by maya steps: 3% -> 20% -> 100% over 20m
sre-liz: alerting: canary errors >1% OR p95 increase >800ms -> PAUSE + auto-pin. tracing=on (100%).
infra-andy: added a quick prober that toggles header-client-version; pushed smoke test ci/platform#332
deploy-bot: canary progress: 3% -> 20% (10m) metrics nominal
sre-liz: small burst of 502s on shard s-07, tenant t-991. requesting logs
raj: logs: ```2025-04-01T02:26:03Z GET /v2 502 tenant=t-991 upstream: grpc-unavailable```
ops-jen: recommend pin tenant t-991 to v1 and pause rollout while infra looks at gRPC upstream.
maya: do the pin. also flag onboarding customers that might be impacted.
deploy-bot: tenant t-991 pinned -> v1 (ttl=1h) reason: upstream grpc-unavailable job 9007 status: PAUSED
mobile-team: monitoring SDK crash logs; no client-side regressions seen.
infra-andy: investigating upstream grpc pool on shard s-07, will report in #eng-infra.
sre-liz: created incident stub and assigned to infra-team. tagging @raj.
raj: collecting model/container logs now, will post findings soon.
maya: thanks all. reconvene 02:35 UTC to decide resume vs rollback. :thumbsup:
